hook: Fold a 0.1 mm sheet of paper 42 times. How thick is it?
sub: Guess a number before the end
milestones: About as tall as a 30-storey tower
Taller than the world's tallest building (828 m)
Past the Space Station's orbit (~400 km)
end: Every fold doubles the thickness. That's how fast doubling grows.
(In real life, even record attempts stopped at about 12-13 folds.) What did you guess?
